title: Cozy 1BR Rosemary Beach Flat with Private Beach Access
meta_description: [nodRelax in this cozy 1BR, 1BA Rosemary Beach Rental with Private Beach access, a full kitchen, beach cruiser bikes, and is close to the beach. Sleeps 5.
description_expanded: DescriptionClean, bright, and fresh, Benoit Carriage House is a cozy Rosemary Beach flat with a location that’s tough to top. Located only one block from the bustling town center and a quick stroll from the beach, this comfy and welcoming carriage house is ideal for small families and couples. You’ll be within walking or biking distance of several picturesque parks and glittering community swimming pools, and have a peaceful and charming space to call home.Benoit Carriage House features a vaulted ceiling and a soaring, arched windows that allows plenty of natural sunlight in and adds a lovely feeling of spaciousness. The living area is the definition of laid-back luxury, with a crisp white sofa, two plush armchairs, and a large HDTV sitting on a vintage-inspired sideboard. French doors open to reveal a sun-drenched terrace with a seating area for sipping your fresh mug of coffee each morning.The petite, L-shaped kitchen area is fully equipped with everything you’ll need to prepare fresh banana pancakes, quick snacks for the beach, or a casual dinner. Sea-blue cabinets provide a surprising amount of storage space, and the glossy quartz countertops are a stylish workspace. Premier appliances include a two-burner range, compact refrigerator, dishwasher, and microwave. A dining table with seating for four sits nearby.Climb the stairs to the sleeping area, where a luxurious king-size bed is tucked cozily underneath the eaves and is flanked by two reading lamps. Additional sleeping spots include a custom twin-size berth nestled underneath the staircase and the living room sofa which pulls out. The full bathroom features a tub/shower combo surrounded by beautiful hexagon tiles and a porcelain sink with a sleek chrome faucet.This carriage house shares an outdoor courtyard space with Benoit Cottage, which includes a gas range for grilling fresh seafood or steaks.Benoit Carriage House sits in the ideal sweet spot of Rosemary Beach, allowing you to park your car in the one garage space and leave it there for the duration of your vacation. Walk everywhere from your front door— including local cafes, shops, parks, and attractions— or ride the provided bicycles. The pristine sandy shores and emerald-green waves of the Gulf of Mexico are also only a short stroll away. Choose to spend your afternoons by the pool or on the sand and your evenings enjoying a delicious dinner and live music in the village center— the ideal, relaxing, 30A vacay is all here waiting for you at Benoit Carriage House.PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS:* Professionally designed* Close to the beach* Peek-a-boo gulf views* 2 Complimentary Beach Cruiser Bikes* Clean Bedding Program* High-Speed Wifi* Washer and DryerHOME LAYOUT: (Sleeps 5)MAIN FLOOR:* Open LIVING AREA w/ cathedral ceiling and sleeper sofa* Full KITCHEN* Small DINING SPACE* BALCONY w/ seating area* Full BATHROOM * Twin-size SLEEPING BERTHSECOND FLOOR:* King-size BEDROOM
